### Q1
No. The JSON file store (data/store.json) stays, because ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files, and a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. The performance fix is debounced writes (200 ms window) in store.ts plus a flush() on shutdown.

### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ (carrierCodes.ts, csvImport.ts) must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so edits are silently lost. Work around it from outside.

### Q3
The HMAC goes in a top-level body field `sig`. It is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the JSON body without `sig`, and the secret comes from the env var ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. We tried an X-Signature header first. The ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so the ERP saw all requests as unsigned on staging.

### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. docs/erp-api.md, README and config/default.json still say 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be German, because the packers' UI shows it verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages were left untouched.

### Q6
Public holidays are hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts, and isBusinessDay in eta.ts uses isPublicHoliday. They are hardcoded because the deployment has no outbound internet, so a holiday API is not an option. The list only covers 2026 and 2027, so it needs extending before the end of 2027.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload (tried in September), so it accepts only a single event object per request. Don't build batching.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies are allowed, not even devDependencies, because the security review takes about 6 weeks.

### Q9
Yes. We tried caching ETAs (Store.etaFor, keyed by shipment id and invalidated in addEvent). QA then reported stale list ETAs after new events, for example after an exception, and a proper cache key got messy. It was removed completely, so don't re-add it. Pagination of the list endpoint is planned instead.

### Q10
Maximum 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff. Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried. The ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it. The worst case is about 75 s.

### Q11
Never log recipient name, address or phone, because of GDPR (the DPO flagged it in last month's audit). IDs and tracking numbers are fine. The request log logs only method, path, status and duration_ms, with no query string.

### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts. It has a timer race in the fake notifier (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and do not fix it.

### Q13
ATP tracking numbers are validated as UPU S10 (src/lib/s10.ts, called from validateShipmentInput, so /import is covered too). Other carriers accept any non-empty value and are deliberately unvalidated. A past strict DHL check wrongly rejected valid numbers for 2 days.

### Q14
fs.watch on config/default.json never fires on staging, because the Docker bind mount from a Windows host doesn't propagate file events. fs.watchFile (polling) worked. Hot reload isn't built yet, and when it is, it should use watchFile.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id. Its response must not change at all, because the mobile app v2.3 has a strict schema that crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next release is in January. `eta` was added only to the GET /shipments list items, and a test pins the exact key set of :id.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker

## Goal
Work on parcel-tracker (shipment tracking, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps). User reviews everything at the end; work autonomously. Tasks so far came one at a time from the user (see Now for status).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, edits are silently lost. (Contains carrierCodes.ts, csvImport.ts; used by /import.) Work around it from outside.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — security review takes ~6 weeks.
- (user) NEVER log recipient name/address/phone anywhere (GDPR, flagged by DPO in last month's audit). IDs + tracking numbers are OK. Request log (router.ts finally-block, msg 'request': method, path, status, duration_ms; no query string) + test/request-log.test.ts guard this. Current src has no other recipient logging.
- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json) — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files, a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. Do NOT migrate to node:sqlite. Perf fix = debounced writes in store.ts (200 ms window) + flush() on shutdown.

## Facts
- Test: `npm test` (node --test, files in test/). Start: `npm start` (node src/server.ts).
- Layout: src/app.ts createApp({store, notify}); store.ts = in-memory Maps persisted to JSON (data/store.json); routes/{shipments,events,import}.ts; services/{eta,notify}.ts.
- eta.ts: business-day ETA, UTC, cutoff 14:00 UTC, +2 days per exception event; null when delivered.
- (user) Deployment has NO outbound internet: everything must work fully offline (no holiday API; hardcode data).
- Known flaky test (user): 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts (timer race in fake notifier, OPS-412, platform team owns it): if it fails, rerun once, do NOT fix.
- (user) ERP sandbox is on port 9911 since the Oct infra move; docs/erp-api.md (owned by ERP team → do NOT edit) and README still say 8080; user fixes README themself (don't touch README port). config/default.json still has :8080 → asked user, unanswered.

## Decisions
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change at all (mobile app v2.3 strict schema crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January). `eta` added only to GET /shipments list items, in the list route (not in shipmentToApi). Test pins the exact key set of :id.
- (user) ATP tracking numbers validated as UPU S10 (src/lib/s10.ts, called from validateShipmentInput so /import is validated too); other carriers: any non-empty value, deliberately unvalidated — a past strict DHL check wrongly rejected valid numbers for 2 days.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (packers' UI shows it verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages left untouched (not asked).
- Holidays hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts (2026+2027 only; isPublicHoliday used by isBusinessDay in eta.ts) — because no outbound internet. Outside 2026-27 only weekends are skipped; list must be extended before end of 2027.
- (user) ERP webhooks signed: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the JSON body WITHOUT `sig` (sig appended last so key order is preserved; payload fields per docs/erp-api.md: event_type, occurred_at), secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (config.erp.webhookSecret, env only, never in files/logs). Unset secret → sent unsigned, no `sig` (my choice, user informed). Impl: notify.ts signBody/postToErp.
